domainModelPath.description: Path to the domain model markdown file that starts the overall workflow.

metadataPath.description: Optional path to an existing metadata JSON file. If omitted, the workflow should run domain-model-parser first.

entityDirectoryPath.description: Path to the generated entity classes consumed by page-generation. Required when the upstream entity generation stage runs outside this skill suite.

schemaOutputPath.description: Optional target path for the generated SQL DDL file.

solutionPath.description: Optional path to the solution file used by solution-code-formatter.

formatSolution.description: Whether to invoke solution-code-formatter after generation completes.
